fields.label: Factory Configuration
fields.description: Legacy factory names retained for migration. Maintain factories in Factory List.

fields.label: Factory List
fields.description: Legacy factory names retained for migration only.

fields.label: One-Time ERPNext Item Creation
fields.description: Configure direct mappings for future Item creation only. Changes never update existing ERPNext Items.

fields.label: Created Item Group
fields.description: Required for controlled one-time Item creation.

fields.label: Created Stock UOM
fields.description: Stock and barcode UOM for the generated variants.

fields.label: Item Field Mappings
fields.description: Administrator-managed field mappings from Design Code or Production Item to ERPNext Item. Item creation requires a separate preview and confirmation.

fields.label: Discussion Attachment Retention
fields.description: Applies only to new private attachments sent from Design Code and Mood Board discussions. Changes do not alter expiry dates of previously uploaded files.

fields.label: Keep Chat Attachments Without Expiry Up To (MB)
fields.description: Files at or below this size stay available without automatic expiry. Files strictly larger receive an expiry date. 1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes. Allowed range: 1–500 MB.

fields.label: Large Chat Attachment Retention (Days)
fields.description: Files above the threshold expire this many calendar days after upload. Allowed range: 1–365 days. The daily cleanup removes expired attachments without deleting chat messages.

fields.label: Mood Board Base Team Template
fields.description: Configure roles and users inserted by Add Base Roles. Existing Mood Board assignments are never replaced.

fields.label: Use Configured Mood Board Base Team
fields.description: When unchecked, use the original six-role template with users selected on each Mood Board.

fields.label: Base Team Roles and Users
fields.description: Select active module-role members; multiple users per role are allowed, with at most one default per role.

fields.label: Security & Permissions
fields.description: Use the 13 approved module roles. Assign each user a role, then enable enforcement after completing Demo role UAT.

fields.label: Enforce Module Role Permissions
fields.description: Safe rollout: when unchecked, existing ERPNext permissions remain effective. When checked, configured role permissions further restrict module access.

fields.label: Module User Roles
fields.description: Assign one or more configured Marina Design module roles per ERPNext User.
